purpose: Prepare a custodian request for an independently reusable synchronized HRS station-to-vehicle holdout.

update_note_2026_10_10.reason: The official GTI station-evaluation report was rechecked as a concrete custodian lead; it lists the required logger channels but does not expose a reuse-cleared raw archive.
update_note_2026_10_10.source_boundary: Report metadata and channel requirements only; no numerical rows admitted.
update_note_2026_10_10.official_h2fills_route_note: The NLR H2FillS page describes empirical fueling-data validation and a full station-to-FCEV model; the H2FillS manual lists station, dispenser and vehicle result channels. The public page requires registration for downloads, so no raw rows or validation result are admitted.

priority_lead_2026_10_10.source_boundary: Official report and aggregate plotted channels only; no raw logger rows or reuse licence admitted.
requested_custodian_package: tank geometry, sensor locations and calibration uncertainty
bank-switching, valve, precooler, stop, fault and ESD states
SAE J2601-5 controller inputs and protocol phase
written permission for derived metrics and journal publication

staged_intake.rationale: The current local corpus is substantial for station-side dynamics; the missing evidence is the synchronized receiving-vessel boundary, not additional station historian volume.

minimum_useful_component_bundle.rationale: A small de-identified bundle can close a useful component-evidence gap without asking the custodian for the full historian. It is intentionally below the eight-event full-loop requirement.

custodian_routes.requested_scope: Original synchronized H70 station, hose, receptacle, vehicle-manifold and vehicle-tank logger rows with mass flow, bank switching, precooler, stop/fault/ESD state, J2601-5 controller inputs, calibration metadata and permission for derived metrics.

De-identified station acquisition and fueling-log traces: vehicle start pressure/temperature, vehicle end pressure, dispenser inlet pressure/temperature, compressor/precooler state, flow or dispensed mass, fill type and safety incident markers

Custodian-run de-identified fueling-event export from the NFCTEC station-data programme: start/end hose and vehicle pressure-temperature, dispensed mass, ambient temperature, station state and safety/fault markers
H70/H35 station, dispenser, protocol and vehicle logger rows

Registration/custodian request for the empirical H2FillS fast-flow validation records and HDVS/NLR station-to-vehicle logger export: common-clock station, hose, receptacle, vehicle pressure-temperature, mass flow or totalizer, selected cascade bank, precooler/compressor state, protocol phase, stop/fault/ESD state, calibration metadata and reuse terms.
Light-duty station events with vehicle pressure/temperature/mass-flow channels

Custodian-controlled 2016-2020 HRFF event and historian export underlying the reported 4,500 refueling events and 8,800 kg dispensed: synchronized vehicle/hose pressure-temperature, mass or totalizer, compressor/precooler state, stop/fault markers, channel dictionary, calibration metadata and reuse terms. The article is an aggregate lead only; no numerical rows are admitted until a pre-access freeze is completed.
De-identified Gen-IV station fueling events with hose/vehicle pressure-temperature endpoints, dispensed mass and equipment state
De-identified back-to-back station-to-vehicle events with pressure, cooling, vehicle SOC and protocol chronology
Six reported real-HRS scenarios and their synchronized logger export
Railway HRS and vehicle pressure/temperature/flow logger rows
Fast-fill gas-path and tank traces with calibration metadata
Station test logs and Appendix A workbook
Instrumented heavy-duty fill logs and controller/protocol states

claim_boundary: This is a request specification, not evidence of access, validation, safety or IJHE readiness.
